text: 10 OVERDOSAGE 10.1 METVIXIA Cream Overdose METVIXIA Cream overdose has not been reported. 10.2 Aktilite Red Light Overdose Red light overdose (excess illumination time) using Aktilite CL128 following METVIXIA Cream application has not been reported. If red light overexposure were to result in a burn, the patient should be treated in accordance with standard practice for treatment of cutaneous burns.
